population: lineage-clean train1421 only; four query-grouped OOF folds; 611/581/internal/development/confirmation outcome sets sealed
target_contract: fresh CANON-P0 Qwen3-8B V8 prefix chain
answer_encoding: stable signed-hash word unigram/bigram 1024-d; this is a cheap lexical encoding, not a full semantic encoder
existing_representation: frozen V8 query/packet embeddings, normalized selected/remaining means; no new encoder calls
model: shared four-class linear probe; cross entropy; full-batch AdamW lr=0.05 weight_decay=0.01; 80 epochs; seed=20260920; no tuning against OOF outcomes
risk_ranking: lowest OOF predicted probability of fail-at-probe/success-at-depth10; train-fold score quantile chooses each early-exit fraction
cost_contract: Every enabled early probe is charged prompt+generated tokens, and a depth10 fallback is charged on CONTINUE. No-probe baseline is separately reported. Critic inference and latency are not yet charged; any claimed Pareto gain must exceed them.
purpose: Diagnostic of whether full current answer and remaining evidence improve cross-query deployment decisions; no checkpoint or final opening gate.
post_result_descriptive_addendum: After observing the primary OOF result, rerun the same fixed linear probe at 25/50/75/100 percent hash-selected train queries to assess whether more independent data plausibly helps. Exploratory only; not a preregistered gate.
